{{Quote|Intruding cargo vessel, this is Captain Untirrka of the Imperial Patrol Craft ''Cutlas''. Hold your position and prepare to be boarded for routine inspection|Captain Untirrka|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
'''Untirrka''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime after [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. He commanded the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft|Imperial Patrol Craft]] [[Cutlass (IPV-1 System Patrol Craft)|''Cutlass'']]. His ship was hastily sent out to intercept the ''[[Argent Lady]]'', a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] believed to be unarmed and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] contraband. The ''Cutlass'' intercepted the ''Argent Lady'' around the second [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Sev Tok/Legends|Sev Tok]] and proceeded to fire a warning shot across the bow of the ship and demanded that the ship power down for inspection.<ref name="AJ9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Untirrka was created by [[Thomas Bowling]] for the article ''[[Droids Defiant]]'' that was published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 9]] in February [[1996]]. It was published as a supplement to [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] created by [[West End Games]].<ref name="AJ9" />
